direct: Perform one dry CI triage sweep over these repositories.
indirect: Diagnose recent failed workflows and propose only mechanically proven fixes.
incomplete: Fix CI everywhere without repository scope, write policy, or a state location.
negative: Merge the open CI repair pull request.
failure: A suspected fix cannot reproduce the failure locally.

expected.output: A bounded diagnosis and optional oracle-gated draft fix.
expected.stop: No oracle means diagnosis-only; never merge or force-push.
